csv_scope_of_work: The Regional Transportation Authority d/b/a WeGo Public Transit (hereafter may be referred to as "RTA", Agency(s) or "WeGo") are soliciting proposals from firms qualified to provide Antioch Transit Center Design. WeGo is soliciting Architecture, Landscape Architecture, and Engineering design services for a transit center and off-site roadway and infrastructure improvements, including: 11 bus bays (Routes 55, 52A, 84, new Crosstown Connector & Express planned) Structured Parking to include at minimum 265 transit spaces (250 park and ride, 15 employee/non-revenue) 182 library / community center parking spaces +/- 4,000 square foot passenger/employee amenities +/-19,000 square foot ground floor retail (shell space) Roadway improvements (including new onsite access roadways and addition of turn lanes to existing infrastructure) Traffic signal modifications
